# `funding_source`

Area: **billing** ([all tables](README.md))

Credit sources beside payments and credit notes: positive adjustments, received transfers and restored debit sources. Bounded with allocations, payouts, holds and consumption.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | Immutable source identity. |
| `kind` | `text` | no |  | adjustment, transfer or reversal; funding order follows payments and credit notes. |
| `billing_account_id` | `uuid` | no |  | Account the credit belongs to (the receiver for a transfer). |
| `currency` | `text` | no |  | Account currency. |
| `action_id` | `uuid` | no |  | Introducing action (the reversed debit for a reversal source). |
| `consumption_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | Debit consumption a reversal source restores, exactly once. |
| `amount` | `numeric(12,2)` | no |  | Exact positive credit. |
| `available_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | Injected-clock commit instant from which the credit is spendable. |
